column1: # Fallback values of the configuration GUI
# Values the GUI uses only when a configuration file of
# 30_Simulation/02_Config/ has an invalid or missing row AND its
# Default_ file under 00_Validation/ has no matching row either
# that the app never stops while loading. A row filled with them is
# painted red in the app until it is saved. They are not simulation
# parameters: the simulation never reads this file.
# Validation of the values typed in the GUI
# Largest distance to the nearest whole number that an Integer
# parameter of Parameter_config.csv may have and still count as whole.
